headline: US Markets Rebound as Yields Rise Following Strong Jobs Report
summary: The Nasdaq rebounded at the open following an AI-related sell-off, while US Treasury yields rose after a stronger-than-expected jobs report. Meanwhile, Canada reported its unemployment rate reached a six-month high.
why: US Treasury yields are a primary benchmark for global borrowing costs; a strong jobs report often signals potential for higher interest rates, which can pressure equity valuations.

impacts.why: Market sentiment improved following an initial AI-driven sell-off.
